0.description: we are aware that there are still more issues in dungeons for interrupt for Mana-Forged Barrier, we are doing our best to cover as many as we can as quickly as possible. When reporting these issues, please include the creature and/or spell ID.
Magistrate Barthilas in Stratholme Service Entrance "Crowd Pummel" ability can no longer interrupt you when using Mana-Forged Barrier.
Baroness in Stratholme can no longer shriek and silence you when using Mana-Forged Barrier.
Gargoyles and Banshee's Silencing shriek can no longer silence you when using Mana-Forged Barrier.
Fixed an issue where Gordok Brutes could knock you up when using Mana-Forged Barrier.
Fixed an issue where Gordok Brutes could interrupt you when using Mana-Forged Barrier.

7.description: [Cauterizing Flames] An error caused the previous fix applied to Cauterizing Flames to be reverted. Cauterizing Flames will no longer be castable while moving as intended.

[Pending Restart] Blazing Barrier's triggered Blast Wave no longer knocks back. Its slow duration now lasts for 3 sec, changed from 2. (It was giving too much power for an RE, especially vs melee, in the new rarity system.)
[Pending Restart] Lightning Discharge stun now lasts for 1.5 sec, changed from 2. The effect now has a 20 second cooldown.

5.description: Reduced the Stamina on the Heart of the Scale base Mythic Version.

1.description: [Pending Restart] The stun from Capacitor Totem now lasts for 3 sec, changed from 4.
[Pending Restart] Pyroblast now deals 10% reduced damage to players while Hot Streak is active.
[Malganis] Flamestrike now deals 10% reduced damage versus players.
[Malganis] Ambush now deals 30% reduced damage versus players, changed from 25%.

7.description: [White Walker] These changes are designed to address an outlier build scenario and reward the more dynamic and diverse rotation options this Mystic Enchant offers, allowing you to continue to deal competitive aoe and single target dps (while using more than 1 button).
[White Walker] Increased the Spell Power scaling of Sinister Strike and Eviscerate while Slice and Dice is active.
[White Walker] Fixed an issue where Slice and Ice no longer applied Spellpower Scaling to Sinister Strike and Eviscerate.
[White Walker] Winds of Winter now has a short cooldown. This change will prevent an outlier method of playing this build that was overperforming in both Single Target and AOE fights.
[White Walker] You can now only gain Fingers of Frost from Eviscerate while White Walker is equipped.
[Tree of Wrath] Living Lightning will no longer share a Cooldown with Chain Heal (patch pending)
[Tree of Wrath] Corrected a tooltip error where the Tree of Wrath Shapeshift stated Living Lightning transformed from Chain Lightning. It transforms from Chain Heal.
[Spell Shredder] Increased the duration of Elemental Shredder buffs from 24 to 27 seconds. This should help maintain your ramp up and stacks on mechanic heavy encounters.
Colossus Smash now works with Heavyweight.

1.description: Fixed an issue where Burnout had an incorrect ICD on the AoE damage explosion.

0.description: [League 3] Players will now obtain crafting recipes for Sanguine gear and components in Prestige boxes for the upcoming release of Molten Core. Sanguine Gear is an upgraded version of Bloodforged with increased PvP Power and Resilience. Additional sources of these recipes will unlock with MC release.
Counterspell from Scholomance can no longer interrupt you under the effect of Mana-Forged barrier.
Shriek from Scholomance can no longer silence you under the effect of Mana-Forged barrier.
Implemented some new handling of Actionbars. Your Actionbars may still have issues after next login, but should be saving properly after that!
Last bosses of all Vanilla raids now give 5 Raider's Comms up from 2.

7.description: Cauterizing Fire now heals for 40% less while you're in an arena or battleground, changed from 20%. (Temporary nerf until design tweaks are coming.)
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Freezing Strikes always gave one stack of Fingers of Frost, even when dual-wielding. It will now correctly grant two stacks if both attacks hit.
[Pending Restart] Fixed the issue where Prayer of Preservation did not grant the Preservation buff at all.

Mystic Enchants like Icy Conjuror, where dealing non-periodic Arcane spells and abilities increase your Frost damage done by 2% per stack now applies on cast, instead of on hit, meaning they are not reliant on travel time of your spells.
Increased the scaling of the triggered damage from Predator's Wrath. This damage is now also considered melee instead of spell, meaning that it uses melee crit chance and crits for 200% damage.
Reduced the base damage and scaling of Wrath of the Plague by 30%.
Reduced the base damage and scaling of Insect Swarm (Plague) by 25%.
Prophet of Wrath now also increases the damage of your Holy and Arcane spell criticals by 25% while affected by Divine Illumination.
[Elemental Destruction] Fixed an issue where scaling from Elemental Immolation was being multiplied.
[Elemental Destruction] Elemental Destruction now increases Elemental Immolation by 10%, from 20%.
[Underused Enchantment Buff] Predator's Wrath now increases the Attack Power scaling of wrath by 12% from 10%.
[Underused Enchantment Buff] Battlemage now has a 40% chance to proc from 30%.
[Underused Enchantment Buff] Increased the base damage and scaling of Spell Slinger by 6% and lowered the ICD by 2 seconds for an 8 second ICD.
[Underused Enchantment Buff] Shadow Strikes now increases Physical and Shadow Damage from just Physical Damage.
[Underused Enchantment Buff] The Damage from Masters of Shadows can now proc from Shadow Bolt if it is consumed via the Nightfall effect.
[Underused Enchantment Buff] Ice Lash now deals 10% more damage to monsters.

[Underused Enchantment Buff] Molten Earth now base damage and scaling increased by 20% due to the Rising Flame talent being changed from Improved Fire Nova, no longer granting damage to Fire Nova and Molten Earth.
[Pending Restart] Blazing Barrier now has a 40 sec cooldown, changed from 35.
[Knight of the Eclipse] Fixed an issue where the PvP modifier on instant cast Wrath was being applied twice.
[Lucifur] Corrected to tooltip on Charred Bite to indicate it deals Fire damage, not Physical damage.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue with the capstone of Improved Feral Spirit.

[Tamed Undead & Demons] Banshee Curse now is a damage overtime effect, ramping up over 18 seconds similar to Curse of Agony, compared to reducing the chance to hit as this effect did not apply in PvE and was volatile in PvP.
[Pending restart] Corrupted Paw now deals 30% less damage versus players, changed from 20%.
[Pending restart] While Corrupted Bear is active you now deal 25% less damage with Shadow Bolt versus players, changed from 15%.
Single-Minded Fury now reduces the damage you do with Mortal Strike, Overpower and Slam by 10%.
Reduced the base damage and scaling of Heart of the Crusader Capstone by 10%.
Reduced the critical strike rating gained from Improved Spirit Tap to 7/15%, down from 10/20%.
Increased the base damage and scaling of Hurricane by 5%.
Increased the base damage and scaling of Arcane Explosion by 5%.
Increased the base damage and scaling of Searing Pain by 5%.
Fixed an issue where Efflorescence cost 2 Epic Essence instead of 1.

Personal Loot now explains it can contain Marks, Orbs, and Raiders Commendations **OR** Personal Loot.
Mystic Scrolls now describe how to use them in the tooltip.

[Mal'ganis] Prestige now awards 5 Mystic Extracts, 150 Mystic Runes, 50 Mystic Orbs, 2500 Marks of Ascension, and second to highest tier PvE gear with a primary stat selection. 1 of the New Legendary Mystic Enchants.
